title: How to set up Gladly in Claude and other AIs
Gladly MCP server for Claude & ChatGPT | usefulapi
snippet:
# Gladly MCP server
Find customers, read conversations, items and tasks; add internal notes in Gladly. Hosted by **usefulapi**: connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client.

### Pull up a customer and review their conversations
Find a customer by email, phone number or external id. Then list their conversations with topics, status and assignee, oldest first, so an agent sees the history.
### Read the timeline of one conversation
Open a conversation and list its messages, emails, calls and notes in order. Ask the assistant for a short summary before you take over the case.
### Check which tasks are still open for a customer
List the open tasks of a customer with assignee and due date. Use it to see which follow-ups are late before you answer the customer.
### Map topics, inboxes and agents to names
Turn the topic, inbox and agent ids of a conversation into names. Use it to see who owns the case and where it sits.
### Add an internal note after a customer contact
Write an internal note on a conversation, for example a call back request. Only agents see the note. Each call adds a new note.

## How do I connect Gladly?
### Before you connect
The login page asks for your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
Create the token in Gladly → **Settings → API → Create API token**. The agent needs the API User permission. The token is used only to call the Gladly API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.
### Claude claude.ai · Desktop
1. Open **Customize → Connectors**, then click **+ Add → Add custom connector**.
2. Enter the name **Gladly** and this URL, then click **Add**:
https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp
3. Claude opens the login page: enter your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
4. In a chat, click **+ → Connectors** and turn on **Gladly**.
Team and Enterprise: an Owner adds the connector for the organization first.
### ChatGPT chatgpt.com
1. Open [Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins), click **+**, then **Add custom MCP server**.
2. Enter the name **Gladly** and this URL, choose **OAuth** as the authentication, confirm the warning and create it:
https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp
3. ChatGPT opens the login page: enter your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
4. In Plugins, install **Gladly**, then choose it in a chat.

title: gladlynetwork.com/agents.md
snippet:
This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.
### Direct integration (MCP)
1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://gladlynetwork.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://gladlynetwork.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.
Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).
### Browser integration (WebMCP)
When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.
- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.
If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.
- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev
- Agent discovery: this document (`/agents.md`) is the canonical agent
